intro: How to read and write opinions: reasons, advantages, drawbacks and proposals.
p.foro.consejo: The plural is «foros». It is written and pronounced almost like in English.
p.ventaja.consejo: The opposite is «inconveniente». «Tener ventaja» means to be ahead.
p.inconveniente.consejo: It is a masculine noun: «el inconveniente». You also hear «la desventaja».
p.mejora.consejo: It comes from «mejor». A «mejora» makes something work better.
p.propuesta.consejo: It comes from «proponer». A «propuesta» can be accepted or rejected.
p.argumento.consejo: A good «argumento» gives a reason; it does not just say «porque sí».
p.aunque.consejo: With a real fact, indicative: «aunque llueve». With something possible, subjunctive: «aunque llueva».
p.sin embargo.consejo: It is usually followed by a comma: «Sin embargo, …». It is more formal than «pero».
p.por eso.consejo: It goes after the cause: «llueve; por eso me quedo en casa».
p.por una parte.consejo: It goes with «por otra parte»: two sides of the same idea.
p.por otra parte.consejo: You can also say «por otro lado». It is used after «por una parte».
p.además.consejo: It has an accent on the last syllable: «a-de-MAS». It adds one more idea.
b1.titulo: Giving an opinion in an orderly way
b2.f0.texto: In my book club they have changed the day of the meeting.
b2.f1.texto: At first the change bothered me.
b2.f2.texto: However, now there is coffee and pastries at the start.
b2.f3.texto: I do not think changing the day solves the problem.
b2.f4.texto: My proposal is to choose shorter books.
b2.f5.texto: On the one hand, that idea seems good to me.
b2.f6.texto: On the other hand, the organiser should ask the members.
b2.f7.texto: We will do a survey this week to decide.
b4.titulo: Connectors: sin embargo, por eso, aunque
b4.texto:
These connectors join ideas:

- **Sin embargo** and **pero** mark contrast: **me molestó; sin embargo, ahora me gusta**.
- **Por eso** gives a consequence: **el sábado es cómodo; por eso vienen más personas**.
- **Por una parte… por otra parte** presents the two sides of a topic.
- **Aunque** admits something opposite. With a real fact use the indicative: **aunque es caro, vale la pena**. With something possible or uncertain, the subjunctive: **aunque sea caro, lo compraré**.

When writing, put a comma after **sin embargo**, **por eso** and **por otra parte** when they open the sentence.
b4.e0.texto: That is why I propose a change.
b4.e1.texto: However, now the club has more members.
b4.e2.texto: On the other hand, there is little time to read.
b5.f0.texto: On Saturday morning, the book club meets in a bright room.
b5.f1.texto: On the long table some cups of coffee steam.
b5.f2.texto: The morning sun comes in through the big windows and draws squares of light on the floor.
b5.f3.texto: The members arrive with their worn books and with their opinions.
b5.f4.texto: Raúl leafs through his copy with his fingertips.
b5.f5.texto: Lucía raises her hand and takes the floor with a calm voice.
b5.f6.texto: She talks about the change as about a new door.
b5.f7.texto: The others listen to her with their heads slightly tilted.
b5.f8.texto: Raúl does not interrupt and waits his turn patiently.
b5.f9.texto: In the end everyone accepts a small survey amid laughter and empty cups.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That's it! It presents something that opposes what came before.
b6.o1.refuerzo: The consequence is marked by «por eso».
b6.o2.refuerzo: A wish is expressed with «ojalá» or «quiero que».
b7.frase: Hay poco tiempo; ____ propongo libros cortos.
b7.o0.refuerzo: «Sin embargo» marks contrast; here there is a consequence.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Well done! Little time is the cause; short books, the consequence.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Aunque» admits something opposite; here the ideas go in the same direction.
b7.pregunta: One idea explains the other. Which connector is missing?
b8.frase: La organizadora debería preguntar antes de decidir
b8.traduccion: The organiser should ask before deciding
b9.o0.refuerzo: A point in favour is a «ventaja», the opposite.
b9.o1.refuerzo: A new idea is a «propuesta», not a «inconveniente».
b9.o2.refuerzo: Correct! It is something bad or difficult about an option.
b10.frase: Estoy de acuerdo, ____ cambiar el día no basta.
b10.o1.refuerzo: «Por eso» gives a consequence, not a contrast.
b10.o2.refuerzo: «Además» adds an idea in the same direction.
b10.pregunta: You accept one part and doubt another. What is missing?
b12.o0.refuerzo: That's it! A real fact goes in the indicative.
b12.o1.refuerzo: The subjunctive sounds like something possible; today it really rains.
b12.pregunta: It is really raining today. Which sentence is correct?
p.cambiado.consejo: From «cambiar», to change. «Han cambiado» means they have changed something.
p.molestó.consejo: From «molestar», to bother. The accent on the last «ó» marks the past for «él».
p.bollos.consejo: Sweet round buns, often eaten with coffee. The double «ll» sounds like «y».
p.resuelva.consejo: Subjunctive of «resolver», to solve. It comes after «que» when something is not yet certain.
p.elegir.consejo: The «g» before «i» sounds like «h», so it reads «e-le-HIR». Stress on the last syllable.
p.cortos.consejo: Plural of «corto», short. It agrees with «libros», which is masculine plural.
p.organizadora.consejo: Feminine form of «organizador». It is the person who plans and runs a meeting.
p.debería.consejo: Conditional of «deber». It softens advice, like saying «it would be good to».
p.preguntar.consejo: Here the «u» after «g» is spoken, because it sits before «n». It means to ask a question.
p.socios.consejo: Plural of «socio», member. In Spain «ci» sounds like «thi», as in «gracias».
p.decidir.consejo: From «decidir», to decide. In Spain the «c» before «i» sounds like «th».
p.humean.consejo: From «humear», to give off steam. The «h» is silent, so it sounds like «u».
p.ventanales.consejo: Plural of «ventanal», a very large window. The «v» sounds like «b».
p.opiniones.consejo: Plural of «opinión». The stress falls on «NES», the last syllable.
p.ejemplar.consejo: Here it means one copy of a book, not a model. The «j» sounds like «h».
p.puntas.consejo: Plural of «punta», tip. «Las puntas de los dedos» are the fingertips.
p.inclinada.consejo: Feminine form of «inclinado», tilted. It agrees with «cabeza», which is feminine.
p.interrumpe.consejo: From «interrumpir», to interrupt. The stress falls on «RRUM», and the «rr» is strong.
p.aceptan.consejo: From «aceptar», to accept. The «c» before «e» sounds like «th» in Spain.
p.contra.consejo: It means against, the opposite of «a favor». The stress falls on «KON».
